header: "I WANT TO CHANGE EMPLOYEE DATA" (step 66a; my request, 1 Nov 2026). Typed into the search bar in the person's own words; here I read which change he means. PURE. add "add new employee", "add an employee", "new employee", "register a new employee", "create employee record", "employee addition" modify "edit employee record", "update employee goutam debnath", "modify employee 498880", "change dob of goutam debnath", "correct the date of joining of 498880" delete "delete employee 498880", "remove employee Anil Das", "employee deletion" delegate "delegate employee editing to Rakesh Ojha", "give employee access to X", "authorise X for employee records", "revoke employee access", "who can edit employee records" manage "manage employees", "employee admin", "employee management" My rule: a QUESTION is never a change ("how many employees", "show employees of C&IT", "who is Rakesh Ojha", "employees with a birthday today", "new employees this month"): an action word has to LEAD the sentence (or the sentence is "new employee" in the singular), and the sentence has to be about employees (the word employee, or a date of birth / joining). Words of a NAME further in never act.

members.name: prefill
members.type: { name?: string; ticket?: string; query?: string }

symbols.name: CUE
symbols.sig: const CUE = /\b(?:employee|employees|personnel|dob|doj|d o b|d o j|date of birth|birth date|birthdate|date of joining|joining date)\ …

symbols.name: detectEmployeeAdminIntent
symbols.sig: export function detectEmployeeAdminIntent(typed: string): EmployeeAdminIntent | null

behaviours: a ticket number in the sentence is carried to the panel
a name in a change sentence is carried as the search text (modify, delete) or as the name to add
no name, no ticket: no prefill (the panel opens on its search)
a name that contains an action word is still a name further in the sentence (it is the FIRST word that acts)
the PAX words do not make an employee request (the PAX route has its own reading and goes first)
capital letters, punctuation and extra spaces do not matter
